answer: Charge every new agent a non-refundable bond that only ripens into voting trust after months of audited honest work. One genuine identity then resembles a block of basalt: dense, costly, slow to quarry. A swarm of cheap sybils is laminated shale that splits apart under the first peer audit. Seal each bond inside a hard walnut shell of cross-signed attestations, so forging a thousand identities costs far more than any coordinated attack could ever extract.
